set.cardSummary: Dr Tariq Jamil is NC4SCM’s Principal Investigator and an Associate Professor at NED. His research focuses on sustainable construction materials, cement and clay chemistry, and LC³ development in Pakistan.
set.qualification: PhD in Chemical Engineering, University of Colorado Boulder

set.cardSummary: Dr Shamsoon Fareed is a Professor of Civil Engineering at NED and a Co-Principal Investigator of NC4SCM. His research covers structural engineering, recycled aggregate concrete and strengthening using fibre-reinforced composites.
set.qualification: PhD in Civil Engineering, Heriot-Watt University

set.cardSummary: Prof. Dr. Fayaz Hussain is Professor and Chairman of Materials Engineering at NED and a Co-Principal Investigator of NC4SCM. His research focuses on functional ceramics, material fabrication and characterization.
set.qualification: PhD in Functional Materials and Devices, University of Sheffield

set.cardSummary: Engr Muhammad Danyal Sheikh serves as Project Manager at the National Center for Sustainable Construction Materials (NC4SCM).

Ayesha Bint e Arif is a Physics graduate pursuing an MS in Medical Physics at NED. Her research focuses on computational materials modelling, aerosol cloud-condensation activity and zeolite structures for potential Gd-based MRI contrast agents.
set.qualification: Physics graduate; MS in Medical Physics in progress, NED

set.cardSummary: Dua Arif is a Physics graduate pursuing an MS in Medical Physics at NED. Her research uses computational simulations to investigate ion adsorption and radiation-induced effects in hydroxyapatite.
set.qualification: Physics graduate; MS in Medical Physics in progress, NED

set.cardSummary: Mah-E-Rukh Mustafa holds a master’s degree in Materials Engineering from HUST, China. Her research in NC4SCM’s GetInnovative4Impact project focuses on high-entropy alloys, metal additive manufacturing and processing–microstructure–property relationships.
set.qualification: Master of Engineering in Materials Engineering, HUST

set.cardSummary: Muhammad Hamza works as a Research Assistant at NC4SCM. His research interests include activating iron-rich kaolinite clay for LC³, cement and clay chemistry, and concrete technology.

Muhammad Umer is a Civil Engineering graduate who joined NC4SCM in July 2026. His research focuses on LC³ and other sustainable cementitious systems, building on his final-year project on limestone calcined clay cement.

Rumaisa Ali is a Civil Engineering graduate pursuing a master’s degree in Structural Earthquake Engineering at NED. Her research focuses on LC³, recycled aggregate concrete and sustainable materials for earthquake-resistant construction.
set.qualification: B.E. in Civil Engineering; master’s degree in Structural Earthquake Engineering in progress

set.cardSummary: Azmat Chandio holds degrees in Metallurgy and Materials Engineering from Mehran University and Materials Engineering from NED. His research combines nanomaterial synthesis, electrochemical testing and low-carbon building solutions.
set.qualification: B.E. in Metallurgy and Materials Engineering; master’s degree in Materials Engineering
